title: Release notes — Cursor Cost Tracker (1.0.4)
intro: Burn Rate Guard, Coding stats (AI vs git), 10 UI languages, and a Critical alert Ignore / no-reopen update.

sections.name: New features
items: **Language** — 10 locales via Settings → Language (`cursorCost.language`): English (default), Polski, 简体中文, 日本語, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский, 한국어, Français, Deutsch.

**Burn Rate Guard** — live $/window on Statistics (default 10 min), High burn rate banner, non-blocking $2 / $5 toasts (Snooze can fire again while the window stays high), Settings fieldset (`cursorCost.burnRateGuard`).
**Today + Last N** — warn styling when the live burn window is high and Show warnings is on.

**Coding stats** — landed / AI = % (your effectiveness), if this branch landed, All on Cursor (dashboard Lines Edited) plus Projects split; GitHub noreply / origin/main matching (`cursorCost.codeLinesInsight`).

sections.name: Improvements / Fixes
items: **Critical alert** — Ignore next to Open History. No re-open when the same query’s tokens/cost are revised by the API.
**Monthly cost forecast** — nine chips in a 3×3 grid (Month forecast, Pace, Runs out, Daily pace, Daily budget, To last, days so far / left, leftover).
**Charts** — tokens and cost over time are one cumulative bar per calendar day.

sections.name: Notes
items: Only blocking modal remains the last-query critical alert (10M tokens / $5).
Included Pro $0 events show token throughput on the burn card; dollar toasts need billed costUsd.
minQueries default 2 so a single expensive query stays the last-query critical alert.
Effectiveness is git insertions on the default branch ÷ AI for this repo — not AI − pending.
